security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A text database for research notes
bundle.longDescription: Notebook II keeps research notes and bibliographies as records with fields you name, each holding text of any length. It reads databases from the 1980s DOS program of the same name.
bundle.copyright: Notebook II was a product of Pro/Tem Software, Inc. This is an independent recreation.
